# Pinned build DEPENDENCIES (whole cloned repos we compile against).
#
# These are distinct from vendor/manifest.txt: that pins individual third-party
# FILES copied into our tree (shy_fft.h); this pins whole REPOS we clone beside
# the project (libDaisy, DaisySP) and build static libs from. They are gitignored
# (see /.gitignore) -- not committed -- so without a pin a fresh clone or a stray
# `git pull` inside them silently changes the toolchain under us. deps/setup.sh
# checks the working clones are at these SHAs (a build gate) and can check them
# out.
#
# Format: <name> <repo-url> <sha> <dir>
#
# Rules:
#   - Pin an exact SHA, never a branch -- reproducible + auditable.
#   - To take a newer upstream: update the SHA here, run `make deps` (or
#     deps/setup.sh), rebuild the libs, and re-verify on hardware. libDaisy is
#     load-bearing (drivers, linker template, HAL); a bump is a real change.
#   - The comment after each line is the `git describe` at pin time, for humans.

libdaisy https://github.com/electro-smith/libDaisy.git cc146d5065dd8286078a662e2830bf820c37a612 libDaisy   # v8.1.0-15-gcc146d50
daisysp  https://github.com/electro-smith/DaisySP.git  599511b740f8f3a9b8db72a0642aa45b8a23c3a3 DaisySP    # V1.0.0-25-g599511b
